pages.text: $(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)A bus which functions similarly to $(l:items_blocks_machines/cables)Fluix ME Glass Cable$(/l) or other cables, but it allows its connection state to be toggled via redstone. This allows you to cut off a section of a $(l:ae2_mechanics/me_network_connections)ME Network$(/l).$(br2)When redstone signal supplied the part enables the connection, $(item)ME Inverted Toggle$()

$(item)Bus$() provides the reverse behavior by disabling the connection instead.$(br2)Of note, toggling these may cause the network to reboot and recalculate the connected devices.$(br2)They are $(l:ae2_mechanics/cable_subparts)cable subparts$(/l).
